title: Add RAG scenario tutor quickstart with guided devloop and tool examples
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: onboarding teams need a compact, opinionated RAG quickstart that teaches incremental debugging, deterministic turn-by-turn replay, and safe tool-calling patterns. This PR adds the 'RAG Scenario Tutor' quickstart: an interactive guided example that walks a developer through building a retrieval-augmented agent, instrumenting Redwood Console telemetry hooks, and swapping in local tool stubs (search, vector-store, web-scraper) across TypeScript and Python samples. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for engineers integrating RAG into product flows and to provide a reproducible debugging path for flaky outputs.

What this PR contains: checklist: - add quickstart scaffold and narrative README with step checkpoints and learning objectives - include a lightweight devcontainer and local runner to simulate streaming responses and tool calls - provide TypeScript and Python sample agents demonstrating structured tool output, function-style calls, and safe retries - add a small in-repo mock vector store and search tool for deterministic CI tests - instrument example telemetry hooks and a sample dashboard config for Redwood Console - add e2e smoke script for CI that runs through the guided scenario and verifies expected prompts/outputs - docs site metadata and sidebar entry so the quickstart shows up under "Quickstarts > RAG" - short demo gif (assets/demo-tutor.gif) and a screencast link in the README

Why this is different: unlike previous quickstarts that focus on microservices or single-language examples, the Scenario Tutor emphasizes stepwise pedagogy: checkpoints assert intermediate agent state, a replay file records turn-level events, and the devloop integration lets users iterate locally with the same telemetry surfaced in production. It also favors small deterministic tool stubs so CI can validate behavior without external networking.

Testing notes: ran the smoke e2e locally and in CI. The CI job uses a pinned node/python image, starts the mock tooling service, runs the guided scenario, records a replay file under /tmp/rag-tutor-replay.json and asserts 5 checkpoints passed. CI matrix: node 20 / python 3.11; both passed.

Docs/links: Linear: ENG-1421 contains the design notes and UX script. Demo screencast: https://internal.redwood.dev/screencasts/rag-tutor. Quickstart README: docs/quickstarts/rag-scenario-tutor/README.md.

Migration/rollout: adds a docs site sidebar entry; no runtime changes to the serving runtime. This is purely example/docs code that can be published immediately after merge.

Follow-ups: - extend the tutor with a 'failure injection' lesson for flaky retrievers (ENG-1503) - add a Go stub agent variant if adoption metrics warrant - bake the replay verifier into the eval-harness smoke kit
